review.method: Each upstream it() body was compared with the paired Dart test body: callbacks, wire chunks, expected result/error/status, preview payloads and hydration/join behavior. Names were used only to pair candidates, never as proof of parity.
review.typeTests: The five generation-persistence-types tests are TypeScript-only assertions. The Dart equivalents run dart analyze on positive and negative fixtures so a broken required/typed contract fails the suite; no runtime stand-in is accepted.
review.realDevtoolsIntegration: Generation devtools tests drive the narrow GenerationDevtoolsBridgePort through a recording double for payload assertions, plus one test that wires the real devtools adapter. The preview helper delegates to the canonical devtools implementation.
review.runIds: Upstream swaps the no-op devtools factory for the real bridge in its vitest setup. Transport-only Dart tests keep the shipping no-op default, so they assert the typed run context instead of a /^run-/ prefix.
